gloss: to crawl into; to creep into

definitions.gloss: to crawl into; to creep into; to slip into
definitions.explanation: To enter a place by crawling, creeping, or sneaking in. Can describe physically crawling into a space or figuratively sneaking into somewhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{込|こ}む。

examples.english: The cat crawled under the bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{込|こ}んで⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were playing by crawling into a narrow tunnel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きて、⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I came home exhausted and crawled straight into the futon.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{這|は}う→這う：00094_hau⟧ (to crawl) and ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to go into). Describes entering somewhere by crawling or on all fours. The most common use is ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{込|こ}む, conveying the image of tiredly or eagerly getting into bed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{込|こ}む: to crawl into the futon
- ⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{込|こ}む: to crawl into bed
- ⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{込|こ}む: to crawl into a gap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{潜|もぐ}り{込|こ}む→潜り込む：15190_mogurikomu⟧: to slip into, to sneak in — emphasizes hiding or getting under something
- ⟦{忍|しの}び{込|こ}む→忍び込む：12578_shinobikomu⟧: to sneak in — emphasizes stealth, often with intent to trespass
- ⟦{入|はい}り{込|こ}む→入り込む：04629_hairikomu⟧: to go into, to enter deeply — more general entering, not necessarily crawling

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. Takes the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to mark the destination.
